title: Interrogatory No. 1
details: Who maintained the checkout log on the day of the lantern exhibition?

definitions.exact: The paper or electronic record that identifies demonstration lanterns taken out of or returned to the observatory.
definitions.plain: The list that shows who took a demonstration lantern out or brought it back. Paper and digital versions both count.
